name: Feeling Blu
source:
Watch a shy streamer named Blu and play along with her hidden object games, build your wholesome relationship through quiet moments, make cozy memories and help her find the courage to let someone in… ( ◡‿◡ *)

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4125590/Feeling_Blu/]Steam[/url]]
